name: pmkusumgrid_generate_otp
description: Generates an OTP for Aadhaar authentication to access the PM-KUSUM grid-connected solar service. Preconditions: None. What it does NOT do: It does not verify the OTP or authenticate the user. Failure conditions: Fails if the Aadhaar number is invalid or not linked to the mobile number. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool if the user is already authenticated and has a valid session_token. Limitation: Maximum of 3 OTP generation attempts allowed per hour.

name: pmkusumgrid_verify_otp
description: Verifies the Aadhaar OTP and returns a session_token for authentication. Preconditions: OTP must have been successfully generated. What it does NOT do: It does not check PM-KUSUM eligibility or submit applications. Failure conditions: Fails if the OTP is incorrect, expired, or does not match the Aadhaar number. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool without first generating an OTP. Limitation: The returned session_token expires after 24 hours of inactivity.

otp.description: 6-digit OTP received on the registered mobile number.

name: pmkusumgrid_check_eligibility
description: Checks if a farmer is eligible for the PM-KUSUM grid-connected solar scheme based on land ownership, grid connectivity availability, and scheme-specific rules. Preconditions: Requires a valid session_token. What it does NOT do: It does not submit an application or allocate capacity. Failure conditions: Rejects eligibility if the farmer does not own/lease land, if there is no grid connectivity in the area, or if the land size is insufficient. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool after an application has already been submitted. Limitation: Eligibility is indicative and subject to final DISCOM approval and feeder capacity.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

state.description: State where the land is located.

district.description: District where the land is located.

land_area_acres.description: Total land area available for solar installation in acres.

name: pmkusumgrid_apply_system
description: Submits an application for a grid-connected solar plant installation. Encodes state transition: application_status moves from not_applied to submitted. Preconditions: Farmer must be eligible, have land, and grid connectivity must be available. What it does NOT do: It does not guarantee approval or immediate installation. Failure conditions: Fails and rejects application if requested capacity exceeds allowed limits (kW caps based on land/feeder), or if grid is not available. Invalid usage scenario: Applying when the farmer is not eligible or has already applied. Limitation: Capacity allocation is strictly limited by local feeder capacity and regulatory caps.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

requested_capacity_kw.description: Requested solar plant capacity in kilowatts (kW).

land_survey_number.description: Survey number or Khata number of the land.

name: pmkusumgrid_track_application_status
description: Tracks the status of a submitted PM-KUSUM application. Encodes state transitions for application_status: not_applied -> submitted -> under_review -> approved -> rejected. Preconditions: Application must have been submitted. What it does NOT do: It does not track physical installation progress. Failure conditions: Fails if the application_id is invalid or does not belong to the user. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool before submitting an application. Limitation: Status updates from DISCOMs may lag by up to 48 hours.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the PM-KUSUM application.

name: pmkusumgrid_track_installation
description: Tracks the physical installation of the solar plant. Encodes state transitions for installation_status: not_started -> in_progress -> installed -> verified -> operational. Preconditions: Application must be in 'approved' status. What it does NOT do: It does not monitor energy generation. Failure conditions: Fails if the application is rejected or still under review. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool for an application that was rejected. Limitation: Installation delays or failures may occur due to vendor availability or site issues.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the PM-KUSUM application.

name: pmkusumgrid_monitor_generation
description: Monitors the real-time or daily energy generation of the solar plant. Encodes state transitions for generation_status: not_generating -> generating -> exporting -> idle -> fault. Preconditions: System must be installed, verified, and operational. What it does NOT do: It does not track financial payments or revenue. Failure conditions: Fails if the plant_id is invalid or if the system is not yet installed. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool when the installation_status is not operational. Limitation: Low or zero generation can occur due to weather conditions, and the tool will reflect this without it being a system error.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

plant_id.description: Unique identifier of the installed solar plant.

date.description: Date for which generation data is requested (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: pmkusumgrid_track_exported_energy
description: Tracks net metering data and the amount of energy exported to the grid. Preconditions: generation_status must be 'exporting' and grid must be connected. What it does NOT do: It does not calculate the monetary value of the exported energy. Failure conditions: Fails if the grid is disrupted or if the system is in a fault state. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool if the system is installed but not generating/exporting. Limitation: Mismatch in exported units vs recorded units may occur due to DISCOM meter synchronization delays.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

plant_id.description: Unique identifier of the installed solar plant.

billing_month.description: Month and year for net metering data (YYYY-MM).

name: pmkusumgrid_track_payment
description: Tracks revenue and payment status for surplus energy exported to the grid. Encodes state transitions for payment_status: not_initiated -> pending -> processed -> credited -> failed. Preconditions: Energy must have been exported and recorded via net metering. What it does NOT do: It does not resolve payment disputes automatically. Failure conditions: Fails if no energy was exported or if bank details are invalid. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool before any energy has been exported to the grid. Limitation: Revenue payments may be significantly delayed due to DISCOM processing cycles, and there is no guaranteed revenue if generation is low.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

plant_id.description: Unique identifier of the installed solar plant.

billing_month.description: Month and year for which payment is being tracked (YYYY-MM).

name: pmkusumgrid_report_fault
description: Reports a maintenance issue, system fault, or downtime for the solar plant. Encodes state transition: generation_status moves to 'fault'. Preconditions: System must be installed and operational. What it does NOT do: It does not dispatch a technician instantly or fix the fault remotely. Failure conditions: Fails if the plant_id is invalid. Invalid usage scenario: Reporting a fault for a system that has not yet been installed. Limitation: Technician visits and fault resolution may take up to 7-14 working days depending on location.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

plant_id.description: Unique identifier of the installed solar plant.

fault_description.description: Detailed description of the fault (e.g., inverter failure, panel damage).

name: pmkusumgrid_get_grid_status
description: Checks the status of the local electrical grid and feeder. Encodes state transitions for grid_status: not_connected -> connected -> active -> disrupted. Preconditions: Requires a valid session_token and location details. What it does NOT do: It does not check the status of the solar panels themselves. Failure conditions: Fails if the substation details are invalid. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool to troubleshoot a broken solar inverter. Limitation: Grid disruptions are controlled by the DISCOM and cannot be resolved through this app; solar export will stop during disruptions.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

state.description: State where the grid connection is located.

district.description: District where the grid connection is located.

sub_station.description: Name of the local 33/11 kV substation.

name: pmkusumgrid_get_tariff_details
description: Fetches the current DISCOM tariff rates for exported solar energy under PM-KUSUM. Preconditions: Requires a valid session_token. What it does NOT do: It does not calculate the total revenue for a specific farmer. Failure conditions: Fails if the state or DISCOM name is unrecognized. Invalid usage scenario: Assuming these rates guarantee a fixed monthly income regardless of generation. Limitation: Tariff rates are subject to state policy changes and do not guarantee revenue.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

discom_name.description: Name of the local Distribution Company (DISCOM).

name: pmkusumgrid_raise_grievance
description: Raises a formal grievance for issues such as installation delays, payment delays, or metering mismatches. Preconditions: Farmer MUST have already checked the relevant status (generation, payment, or installation) before raising a grievance. What it does NOT do: It does not resolve the issue immediately. Failure conditions: Fails if the application_id is invalid or if the grievance category is unrecognized. Invalid usage scenario: Raising a grievance without first checking the status of the issue. Limitation: Grievance resolution involves manual intervention by state nodal agencies and may take 15-30 days.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the PM-KUSUM application.

name: pmkusumgrid_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the resolution status of a previously raised grievance. Preconditions: A grievance must have been successfully raised. What it does NOT do: It does not escalate the grievance automatically. Failure conditions: Fails if the grievance_id is invalid or does not belong to the user. Invalid usage scenario: Calling this tool before raising any grievance. Limitation: Status updates may be infrequent as they depend on manual updates from nodal officers.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

grievance_id.description: Unique identifier of the raised grievance.
